summary: First full E2E run for Nas&Neq. Backend: 17/17 pytest pass (menu data/prices, cart validation, idempotency, concurrent last-unit stock, restore-once, admin 401/403/200, status+payment workflow, analytics deltas, CSV, preorder rules incl. lead days and capacity, inquiries, favorites, delivery settings validation). Frontend: home hero scroll-scrub (down 0->36s, up ->14s), CTAs, no Emergent badge, menu (9 pills, 49 cards, ₱x.00, Price to be confirmed), product dialog (add vs inquire), quick-add, cart stepper/remove/subtotal/persistence, guest favorites, checkout (services enabled/disabled, validation, review, submit -> /track/{token}?new=1 with ref), MTO inquiry validation and success, 390px no overflow on 7 pages, admin via Clerk ticket (all 9 tabs, order status accept, menu price edit + image upload preview/use/save reflected publicly, settings delivery 400 then success, delivery selectable at checkout with fee, CSV download), customer: /admin denied, synced favorites survive reload, session persists. Found and FIXED one critical perf bug: /api/images was blocking the event loop.

critical.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: called the sync requests-based get_object() inside an async route, which blocked the whole event loop. When the menu page loaded ~49 images, every other API call (e.g. /api/cart/validate) waited 12-15s, so the cart subtotal stayed stale or at ₱0.00 after qty changes. Wrapped it in asyncio.to_thread; validate during an image burst went from 12.7s to 0.39s.

minor.issue: The Emergent email service returned 429 'email rate limit exceeded' after about 10 sends. Order NN-261029-8E8C and inquiry INQ-36F7E4 owner emails failed, and there is no retry or outbox, so those notifications are lost for good. The failure is recorded and shown in the admin order dialog.

The sync requests.get to the Clerk API runs inside an async dependency (first login only), which blocks the event loop. Use httpx.AsyncClient or asyncio.to_thread. Same for the sync init_storage() on a cold key.
The capacity check is aggregate-then-insert and not atomic, so concurrent pre-orders can exceed daily_capacity.
Body is a raw dict with no Pydantic model (manual validation only).

integration_issues.issue: Was stale or ₱0.00 because of the backend image event-loop blocking (fixed). Also, while a validate is in flight the old subtotal stays visible with no loading indicator.

action_items: Keep the asyncio.to_thread fix in server.py image route; audit other sync IO in async paths (_clerk_user, init_storage)
Add retry/backoff or a persisted outbox + admin 'resend' for failed (429) owner/customer emails
Make preorder daily capacity reservation atomic (e.g. a per-date counter doc with conditional $inc)
Optional: replace native date inputs/selects with shadcn components; show only enabled services in the footer
critical_code_review_comments: server.py image(): blocking IO in async handler (fixed)

Order ref uses token_hex(2) (65k/day) with a unique index; a collision raises an unhandled DuplicateKeyError branch that looks for the idempotency_key, so it returns 500 'Could not create the order'. Retry ref generation instead
pytest: run with -n 0 (the xdist parallel workers share the module cleanup fixture)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows after the backend fix

The fixture temporarily sets notify_email to delivered@resend.dev to avoid owner emails, then restores it. Get a UI admin login with: python clerk_ticket.py admin|customer (prints a sign-in URL, single use). The email service is currently rate-limited (429).
rca of the issue: Cart subtotal stale/₱0: CartSheet's useCartCheck posts /cart/validate on each cart change. The backend image route did a synchronous requests.get to object storage inside async def, which serialized the event loop, so with ~49 menu images queued every validate response took 12-15s. Repro: fire 20 parallel /api/images requests, then time /api/cart/validate (12.7s). Mitigation applied: await asyncio.to_thread(get_object, path), giving 0.39s.
